title: Measuring an Artificial Intelligence System’s Performance on a Verbal IQ Test For Young Children
reasoning: The paper uses a children's Verbal IQ test (WPPSI-III) as a metric for evaluating an artificial intelligence system (ConceptNet). While the test includes subtests like 'Comprehension' that involve social common sense and understanding of social situations, it does not focus on or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as primary research objectives.
